rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the activity or process of reading written language.

example.traditional: 呢篇文章值得大家閱讀。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 zik6 dak1 daai6 gaa1 jyut6 duk6

rows.note: Use this for the value shown by a meter, gauge, or other measuring device.

example.jyutping: go3 din6 biu1 ge3 duk6 sou3 m4 ngaam1

rows.note: Use this when referring to material intended to be read rather than the activity of reading.

example.english: This is reading material for children.
example.traditional: 呢本係畀小朋友睇嘅讀物。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 hai6 bei2 siu2 pang4 jau5 tai2 ge3 duk6 mat6

rows.note: Use this for a particular interpretation of a text, event, or issue.

example.english: The expert has another reading of this matter.
example.traditional: 專家對呢件事有另一個解讀。
example.jyutping: zyun1 gaa1 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 jau5 ling6 jat1 go3 gaai2 duk6
